claim: Symbol-grammar (G family) calibrated distance to VM is the lowest or near-lowest comparable family for all five candidate/representation combinations at both comparable checkpoints (5000, 10000)
supporting_metrics: G family rows, all 5 reps, ck 5000+10000 (SCIENTIFIC_INTERPRETATION_EVIDENCE.tsv family=G)
contradicting_metrics: none within G; magnitude itself is large in absolute terms for C06
uncertainty: bootstrap CI moderate for G01/G04/G06-G08; wide for none of the G metrics specifically
representation_sensitivity: HIGH: C01 vs C02 G-family raw values differ by up to 623% relative (G02_INITIAL_RESTRICTION_DENSITY) and 93.5% (G01_ALPHABET_SIZE); see C07
notes: Lowest among compared families is a within-run relative statement, not a similarity verdict; no frozen closeness threshold exists (see C13)

claim: Token-formation (T family) calibrated distance to VM is roughly one to two orders of magnitude larger for C06 (mensural music) than for C01/C02 (Latin) at both comparable checkpoints
uncertainty: T08_HIGHER_ORDER_PREDICTIVE_GAIN and several T-family regimes have moderate bootstrap CI width; not dominant
representation_sensitivity: EXTREME across C06 representations (R1 vs R2 differ ~25x); see C09
sample_size_sensitivity: rank stable: T remains the largest-distance family for all three C06 representations at both checkpoints
notes: Descriptive only; does not by itself indicate why (see alternative explanations, report section 16)

claim: Sequence-grammar (S family) is the largest-distance comparable family for C01/C02 (Latin), but is not the largest for any C06 representation (T and D exceed it); for MUSIC-R1 specifically S is the second-lowest family
supporting_metrics: AGGREGATE_SUMMARY.tsv S rows all reps/checkpoints; family_rank_* summaries
uncertainty: several S04-S07 regimes are DEGENERATE (excluded, "metric absent from pre-frozen scale"), so the S family mean is computed over a subset (S01,S02,S03,S08 x 5 regimes = 20 of a possible larger set)
representation_sensitivity: S01_TRANSITION_DENSITY[TOP_250] example: 6.96 (R1) vs presumably different for R2/R3 (representation-dependent, not separately re-verified per-metric here)
notes: Illustrates that no single family orders candidates identically to VM; picture is multidimensional (report section 12)

claim: Document-hierarchy (D) and line-grammar (L) metrics are NOT_COMPARABLE between VM and C01/C02, because VM's frozen source observes only document and physical-line levels while C01/C02 observe document/locus/page/section but not physical line
supporting_metrics: candidates/C01/RAW_METRICS.tsv (D_LOCUS/D_PAGE/D_SECTION comparable, D_LINE/L not comparable, reason "line not observed"); AGGREGATE_SUMMARY.tsv D,L rows for C01/C02 all NOT_COMPARABLE
uncertainty: not applicable (status is schema-level, not a measured effect)
notes: This is a genuine structural non-overlap between the two sources' observed hierarchy levels, not a data-quality defect and not evidence of any structural relationship

claim: The representation choice within C06 (MUSIC-R1 vs R2 vs R3) changes the family-mean calibrated distance to VM by more than the spread across candidate identity (C01, C02, C06-mean), for every comparable family, at both checkpoints
supporting_metrics: AGGREGATE_SUMMARY.tsv, all families/checkpoints (e.g. T: R1-R3 spread 1794-3507 vs class spread 709-1387; D: R1-R3 spread 149-177 vs class spread 0 (D not comparable for C01/C02))
uncertainty: direct computation from frozen outputs, no additional statistical uncertainty introduced
representation_sensitivity: this claim IS the representation-sensitivity measurement
sample_size_sensitivity: checked at both 5000 and 10000; pattern holds at both
notes: Central finding for report sections 6 and 17: representation variance exceeds observed candidate-class variance in this N=3 panel

claim: D-family *_PROGRESSION metrics (D_LINE_PROGRESSION, D_SECTION_PROGRESSION, D_PAGE_PROGRESSION, D_LOCUS_PROGRESSION) have bootstrap 95% CI widths several times larger than the absolute point estimate, across every candidate/representation where they are comparable
supporting_metrics: BOOTSTRAP_RESULTS.tsv: e.g. C01 D_PAGE_PROGRESSION est=-0.000143 CI=[-0.000507,0.00125] (rel width 12.35); C02 D_LOCUS_PROGRESSION rel width 5.50; C06-R1 D_PAGE_PROGRESSION rel width 2.95
uncertainty: this claim is itself an uncertainty statement
notes: These specific metrics should carry LOW interpretive weight ("sample-size-sensitive"/near-zero-signal) regardless of candidate; see report section 11

claim: Latin representation choice (EXPANDED vs DIPLOMATIC) shifts G01_ALPHABET_SIZE (+93.5%), G02_INITIAL_RESTRICTION_DENSITY (+623% from a small base), and G04_BIGRAM_OCCUPANCY (-56.2%) by magnitudes comparable to or larger than the calibrated candidate-vs-VM distances reported for those same metrics
contradicting_metrics: S-family deltas are comparatively small (-12% to -23%), showing sensitivity is family-specific, not uniform
uncertainty: delta values are raw differences, not resampled; no CI attached to the delta itself in this run
representation_sensitivity: this claim IS a representation-sensitivity measurement for the Latin pair
notes: Motivates report section 5: C01/C02 must not be read as two independent historical controls

claim: The direction of change (5000 to 10000 tokens) in a candidate's own rarefied metric estimate agrees with the direction of change in VM's own rarefied estimate for the same metric in only 165 of 360 (46%) checked (representation, metric) pairs — close to chance
supporting_metrics: Derived from rarefaction/*/RAREFACTION_SUMMARY.tsv (candidate) and VM_RAREFACTION_V2.tsv (frozen VM), matched by metric_id/regime/checkpoint
contradicting_metrics: 195 of 360 pairs (54%) disagree, i.e. majority is technically "disagree" but the split is close to 50/50
uncertainty: near-chance split is itself the finding; not a strong signal either way
sample_size_sensitivity: compares only the two jointly-reachable checkpoints (5000, 10000)
notes: Rules against a single dominant, uniform, shared corpus-size drift across the whole panel; does not rule out a real per-metric size effect

claim: VM's structural grammar is broadly closer (smaller calibrated distance) to the tested natural-language Latin representations (C01, C02) than to the tested mensural-music representations (C06 R1/R2/R3), based on the T family, the only family directly comparable for both classes that shows a clear direction
contradicting_metrics: G family magnitudes are comparable across candidate classes (not clearly favoring Latin); S family favors MUSIC-R1 specifically but not R2/R3; D is large for music but has no C01/C02 value at all (C04), so it cannot corroborate this claim, only describe music on its own
uncertainty: family-mixed picture; only one of three directly-comparable families agrees with this direction
representation_sensitivity: R1/R2/R3 variance (C05) means the "Music" side of this claim is representation-dependent, weakening it
notes: Phase II hypothesis-relevant (report section 12/14); explicitly a within-family pattern resting on T alone, not a composite score (none was computed)

claim: VM's structural grammar resembles a constrained, non-natural-language symbolic notation (mensural music, as tested here) more closely than it resembles natural language (Latin, as tested here)
supporting_metrics: Only S-family for MUSIC-R1 specifically supports this
contradicting_metrics: T family (the one directly-comparable family with a clear direction) does not support this; G family on balance does not support this either; D has no Latin counterpart to compare against, so it neither supports nor contradicts this claim; C05 (representation instability) further weakens any Music-specific claim
notes: The one directly-comparable family with a clear signal (T), plus G, point the opposite direction from this claim

claim: VM was produced using, or is structurally consistent with, a Giovanni Fontana-style external-memory/mnemonic device (Secretum-type mechanism)
supporting_metrics: none — this design does not measure device-level retrieval procedures, key/convention dependence, or the (X,K,V) mechanism triples that Phase II's own retrospective (research/phase2/PHASE2_FAILURE_ANALYSIS.md) identified as required and unavailable
uncertainty: not applicable — outside this design's measurement scope
notes: This comparative-notation design measures aggregate structural distance to a real notation-system class (music), not device mechanism, retrieval, or historical authorship; see report section 15. Phase II's dedicated mechanism-identification experiment already concluded MECHANISM_IDENTIFICATION_FROM_F2=NOT_IDENTIFIABLE on a different, purpose-built design

claim: The observed VM-vs-C06 distance pattern is explained by generic properties of the chosen encoding (e.g. MUSIC-R2's signed-interval token alphabet, MUSIC-R1's compound event tokens) rather than by any historically specific mechanism
supporting_metrics: C05 (representation variance exceeds class variance); G01_ALPHABET_SIZE varies enormously by representation choice for C01/C02 too (C07), showing token/alphabet-inventory choice generically drives G/T-family metrics
contradicting_metrics: none ruling this out; this design cannot distinguish "generic notation-encoding effect" from "historically specific effect" because no second independent music encoding of unrelated provenance was tested
uncertainty: inherent: this is an interpretive claim about causation, not a direct measurement
notes: Report section 16 "alternative explanations"; cannot be confirmed or ruled out with N=1 real corpus per class
